# A jellyfish: a faceted pink dome 0.7 m across, a cream rim, four tentacles 0.6 m. Origin at the
# dome's base (the game pulses it). Unlit. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Dome --base-color 1.000 0.655 0.647 --no-slot --emission 1.000 0.655 0.647
material new Frill --base-color 1.000 0.906 0.839 --no-slot --emission 1.000 0.906 0.839
add mesh ico-sphere --name Dome --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.36 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 1 0.8
apply --scale
active Dome
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z < -0.05"
scale 1 1 0.1
mode object
material assign Dome
add mesh cylinder --name Rim --vertices 8 --radius 0.38 --depth 0.08 --location 0 0 -0.02
material assign Frill
add mesh cube --name T0 --size 1 --location 0.18 0 -0.33
scale 0.08 0.08 0.6
add mesh cube --name T1 --size 1 --location -0.18 0 -0.38
scale 0.08 0.08 0.7
add mesh cube --name T2 --size 1 --location 0.05 0.12 -0.42
scale 0.08 0.08 0.8
add mesh cube --name T3 --size 1 --location -0.05 -0.12 -0.3
scale 0.08 0.08 0.55
select T0 T1 T2 T3
apply --scale
material assign Frill
select all
shade flat
export jelly.glb
